title: Geopolitical uncertainty
summary:
Main
By Nikolaos Tagoulis
The Middle East conflict entered a new phase following the Houthis' imposition of a naval blockade against Saudi Arabia, adding to geopolitical uncertainty. Beyond attacks on vessels, recent reports that a Houthi strike forced the 400,000-bpd Jazan oil refinery to halt operations demonstrate that the Houthis are also willing to target energy infrastructure. This escalation comes at a time when Saudi Arabia increasingly relies on its west coast to maintain commodity exports following the disruption of traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.
